{{Top}} {{Youmay|the [[Resistance]] mission to [[Bracca]]|the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Mission on Bracca]]}} {{Mission |prev=[[Escape from Akiva]]''[[Resistance Reborn]]'' |conc=*[[Mission to Corellia]] *[[Attack on Ryloth]] |next= |image=[[File:ZayVersio-SWZ66.png]] |name=Mission to Bracca |conflict=[[First Order-Resistance War]] |objective=Obtain [[starship]]s for the [[Resistance]] |date=[[34 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |place=[[Bracca]] |result=*Resistance victory **[[Dross Squadron]] obtains multiple [[X-wing starfighter]]s |side1=Resistance |side2=[[First Order]] |side3= |side4= |commanders1=[[Dross Leader]] [[Shriv Suurgav]] |commanders2=[[Unidentified First Order officer (Bracca)|First Order officer]]† |commanders3= |commanders4= |unit1=*Dross Squadron *[[Bracca resistance]] |unit2=*[[First Order Army]] **[[Stormtrooper Corps (First Order)|Stormtrooper Corps]] |unit3= |unit4= |ppl1=*Several [[Scrapper Guild]] workers **[[Puwanini]] *6 [[Resistance pilot]]s **[[Dross Two]] [[Pacer Agoyo]] **[[Dross Three]] [[Raidah Doon]] **[[Wesson Dove]] **[[Sanrec Stronghammer]]† **[[Zay Versio]] *1 [[transport]] |ppl2=*1 [[First Order officer]] *Multiple [[First Order stormtrooper|Stormtroopers]] *1 [[blaster cannon]] |ppl3= |ppl4= |casual1=Sanrec Stronghammer |casual2=*1 First Order officer *Many stormtroopers |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} Sometime after the [[Battle of Crait]], [[Dross Squadron]] undertook a '''mission to Bracca''' to obtain more ships for the [[Resistance]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|Even if we get to Coronet City and Poe and Charth and whoever are able to lift a few First Order ships, it's not enough.''"
"''I agree. That's why I want you to go to Bracca. Put a team together. Take whoever you need and go get as many starfighters as you can.|Shriv Surgav and Leia Organa|}} After the [[Battle of Crait]], which was a massive blow to the [[Resistance]], [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] gathered her forces together at the [[Ryloth Defense Authority base]] on [[Ryloth]], with the permission of her old friend [[Yendor Brethen|Yendor]], and prepared to gather as many ships as possible to be able to fight the [[First Order]], a military [[First Order military|force]] that rose out of the shards of the [[Galactic Empire]]. First, she assigned leader of [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]] [[pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] to go to [[Corellia]] and steal a few ships from the First Order. She then recognized the need to gather more people sympathetic to the Resistance's cause, so, she commanded [[Wedge Antilles]] to lead a cadre to [[Mission to Corellia|break out]] former [[New Republic]] [[senator]] [[Ransolm Casterfo]] from the [[Santhe Shipyards]]. Lastly, she ordered [[Shriv Suurgav]] and [[Dross Squadron]] to go to the location of the [[Scrapper Guild]] on [[Bracca]] and take as many ships as possible from there, as the First Order was sending ships there to be decommissioned and scrapped. With that, the mission to Bracca began. ===Time in hyperspace=== {{Quote|Okay, Dross Squadron, buckle up. Here we go.|Shriv Surgav|}} In [[hyperspace]], tensions were at an all-time high. Shriv noted that Zay, his niece, had been rolling her eyes a lot lately, perhaps due to puberty. While on the way to Bracca, Shriv briefed the team on the mission and informed [[Wesson Dove]] and her [[Marriage|wife]], [[Raidah Doon]] that they'd be going in as [[Hazmat (occupation)|Hazmats]] to get in the facility and steal a few ships. During this flight, Shriv also noticed that Pacer had been acting up, and after rebuking him, he dismissed the young pilot as a "[[space baby]]," which hurt Zay, as she was born in space. But Shriv assured her that her parents would be proud of her hard work for the [[Resistance]]. ==The mission== ===The adventure begins=== {{Quote|It's kind of pretty from up here.''"
"''Sure, if you like depressing space junk.|Zay Versio and Shriv Surgav, on Bracca|}} After arriving out of hyperspace, Shriv once again briefed the team and prepared them, giving them all assignments, a few as [[Rigger (occupation)|Riggers]] and some as [[Hazmat (occupation)|Hazmats]]. Pacer then told the crew what his [[Puwanini|sister]] had told him about there and how ships went into the [[Ibdis Maw]] and that she would be willing to assist, as she hated the First Order as much as he did. And now, with the plans set, the mission to Bracca officially began. ===Landing on Bracca=== {{Quote|Take care, space baby.|Shriv Surgav, to Zay Versio|}} The team was commanded to land on a long, narrow platform. Despite the murky and foggy atmosphere, Shriv could see ships landing and waiting for clearance to take off. After their ship landed, Zay prepared to get out, but Shriv told her that she was going to stay on the ship, much to her irritation and disappointment, as she thought she was old enough for action. But her uncle explained that he wanted her to be their last line of defense because he trusted her the most and he wanted her to continue to fight hard for the Resistance. Zay agreed, and Shriv and the rest of the team set off. ===Putting the plan in motion=== {{Quote|We're gonna win this war?''"
"''Yeah, definitely.|Pacer Agoyo and Shriv Surgav|}} After getting the jumpsuits Pacer's sister had left for them under a pile of trash in a maintenance corridor a few blocks from the train station, Shriv and his team hopped on the transport train, ready for their mission. After the train pulled into a station and came to a halt, Shriv caught sight of the [[Ibdis Maw]], something he wished he hadn't seen. In fact, the [[Duros]] was not able to tell if the separate mouths were individual creatures or multiple mouths on one continent-sized creature. Right then, a squad of stormtroopers rushed in. Though a bit tense and wanting to shoot them out of fear, Shriv kept his calm, and though the danger passed, he could feel Agoyo tensing and preparing to shoot them, making him wonder why the young man loathed the First Order so much. Shriv knew their exit was coming soon, but, he tensed even further as six more stormtroopers were let on at the stop before their stop. Eventually, the problem was settled, and Pacer explained his tension was due to the First Order destroying his [[Pacer Agoyo's hometown|hometown]]. After some encouragement from Shriv and an apology for the rebuke on the ship, the team got off the transport train peacefully. But not for long. A group of stormtroopers stopped them, recognizing Raidah as a known criminal from [[Gheia Six]]. Though at first, they were only going to take Raidah in for questioning, an [[Unidentified First Order officer (Bracca)|officer]] ordered them to take all of Dross Squadron in for questioning. Knowing they could not be taken in for questioning, Wesson threw a knife at the officer and killed him and the two sides exchanged blaster fire. ==Aftermath== Though Stronghammer was killed in action, Dross Squadron was able to steal several starfighters. As the Resistance presence on Ryloth was [[Attack on Ryloth|leaked]] to the First Order, Shriv's group, the Corellia teams, and Organa and the others who had been stationed on Ryloth reunited at a location supplied by the [[Collective]]. The First Order believed Dross Squadron was a rogue grouping of Scrap Guild workers, creating a galactic incident that spread over newsfeeds even as the guild denied that its personnel had carried out the heist. ==Behind the scenes== The mission to Bracca was first seen in ''[[Resistance Reborn]]''. In the text, it is made clear that Zay Versio leaves aboard the same [[transport]] that Dross Squadron arrived to Bracca in. Her ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' card, however, erroneously describes her as flying away in a T-70 X-wing.{{FFGXW2|set=Hotshots and Aces II Reinforcements Pack|cardname=Zay Versio}} ==Appearances== *''[[Resistance Reborn]]'' {{Ab|Resistance Reborn (audiobook)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{EncyclopediaCite|Republic, Rebel, and Resistance Starfighters}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' {{1stID|mission to Bracca}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Hotshots and Aces II Reinforcements Pack|cardname=Zay Versio}} {{1stp}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{FirstOrderResistanceWarNav}} {{Interlang |es=Misión a Bracca }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bracca, mission to}} [[Category:Battles of Bracca]] [[Category:Missions of the First Order–Resistance war]]
